The evidence presented in the text is a forensic report linking the defendant to the crime scene via DNA. However, the credibility of this evidence is significantly undermined by the lawyer’s challenge regarding the forensic lab’s history of mishandling samples and high cross-contamination rates. In legal matters, the integrity of the chain of custody and the reliability of the laboratory procedures are critical; therefore, the lab’s poor track record directly impacts the weight and admissibility of the DNA match.

Regarding your question, the color of grass during summer is typically green, although it may turn brown or yellow in regions experiencing drought or extreme heat.
